item.title: Version 0.3.9
item.description:
Document Vault v0.3.9 introduces hierarchical document labels, portable filing rules, progressive multi-page AI extraction, decoupled reclassification confidence gating, a redesigned Settings tree, Polar.sh licensing, and the updated document-vault.app website.
### Classification, Reclassification & AI Extraction - Hierarchical label paths (Parent/Sub-label) with disk-first folder inference, subtree prefix filtering, and two-tier Vault navigation (#1) - Non-blocking Suggested Labels bar and Bundle Inspector modal to review, rename, override, or preview grouped new label suggestions without blocking filing (#1) - Vault-portable Filing Rules in .document_vault/vault.json with deterministic keyword rules, VLM prompt rules, and 1-click rule creation from Review, Edit, Batch Move, Bundle Inspector, and Settings (#1) - Progressive multi-page PDF scanning (Page 1, last page, then intermediate pages up to 12 pages) with grounded reliability checks across embedded text, 2-digit years, and future-date windows (#1) - Decoupled label and date confidence gating during AI reclassification so low date confidence never blocks label updates (and vice versa), plus faster Category Tag Only reclassification (#22) - Preserved pre-rotation SHA-256 hashes across page rotations so re-uploading an unrotated original still catches duplicates (#16)
### Vault UI, Settings & Filenames - Redesigned Settings categories as an indented hierarchical tree with smooth expand/collapse animations, hover/focus actions, a two-column Taxonomy & Naming Masks layout, and automatic filtering for 10+ labels (#19) - Configurable Title Separator setting (space, underscore, or hyphen) applied across intake previews, approvals, edits, batch moves, and disk-first vault recovery (#18) - Click anywhere on Vault document cards to open preview, card-only hover lift animation, and unified single-document Reclassify with AI workflow with live queue progress (#17) - Fixed VLM model popover stacking above tabs, floating pills, and notifications (#14) - Marked resolved Review/Needs Attention activity rows cleanly and refreshed the UI immediately on dismiss (#16)
### Licensing, Website & Auto-Updates - Integrated Polar.sh 30-document free tier, license key activation/validation, and live locale/timezone currency detection (USD, EUR, CHF) (#1, #15, #16, #20) - Serving product website, interactive Demo Document Vault, and Sparkle appcast feed on document-vault.app (#13, #21)
### Architecture & Quality - Modularized backend services, FastAPI routers, schemas, and native ES/CSS frontend modules with strict architecture line budgets and import boundaries (#7, #8, #9, #10, #12) - Added unified verification suite, Playwright Chromium/WebKit visual benchmarks, real-document corpus pipeline checks, and MLX VLM evaluation harness (#2, #3, #4, #5)
